newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bank Baer cuts Roche estimates.
newsitem.headline: Bank Baer cuts Roche estimates.

text.p: Bank Julius Baer cut its forecast on Roche Holding AG and removed the company from its buy list in response to disappointing first quarter sales.
Baer said it reduced its 1997 earnings per share estimate to 511 Swiss francs from 539.
Roche this week reported that its sales in the 1997 first quarter rose by 18 percent in Swiss francs and by three percent on a local currency basis.
Pharmaceutical division sales were up by 19 percent in Swiss francs and by three percent in local currencies.

Baer said in its report that from a longer-term point of view Roche was worth holding in a portfolio and that it was more optimistic for 1998/99 with earnings growth likely to accelerate from 1998 onward.
Baer reduced its 1998 estimate for the company to 624 francs from 639. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
